lines.text: Monaco Grand Prix, on a yacht. Race day alone: five thousand two hundred euros.
Champagne on deck. Formula One cars screaming past the harbor.
Three race days aboard, for two: eighteen thousand four hundred.
Hotel de Paris, race week: thirty-three thousand euros.
Helicopter from Nice: about eight hundred, there and back.
Sunday after-party: fifteen hundred for two.
Total for one couple: about fifty-four thousand euros. Roughly sixty thousand dollars.
Or a Sunday grandstand seat: nine hundred fifty euros. Which would you pick?
